title: Gate inputs precede their gate
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$ with $k\le n$, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$, and let $j$ be a gate index below the total number of gates in the constructed circuit. Every vertex read by the gate at index $j$ has index strictly less than $n+j$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ bits
